description: This file defines a report parser class for generating an inverted analytic balance report in Odoo, including methods for data retrieval and calculations related to analytic accounts.

classes.name: account_inverted_analytic_balance
classes.description: A report parser class for generating inverted analytic balance reports in Odoo.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser and updates local context with helper methods and data.

methods.name: _lines_g
methods.description: Retrieves analytic account lines grouped by general account within a date range, returning debit and credit amounts.

methods.name: _lines_a
methods.description: Retrieves analytic account lines for specific accounts and a general account, including account details and balances.

methods.name: _sum_debit
methods.description: Calculates total debit amount for given accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_credit
methods.description: Calculates total credit amount for given accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_balance
methods.description: Calculates net balance (debit minus credit) for given accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_quantity
methods.description: Calculates total quantity for given accounts within a date range.
